properties.unofficial_change: Lost the Yawei, Penguia, Kpeje West and Kpeje Bongre chiefdoms and the Falley and Jonga sections of Njaluahun (now Jahn Chiefdom) to Kpanguima District.
Lost the Lower Bambara, Malegohun, Langrama, Niawa and Tunkia chiefdoms to the new districts.

New district (also spelled Kpanguma or Panguma). Made from the Lower Bambara, Malegohun (Kenema), Yawei, Penguia, Kpeje West, Kpeje Bongre (Kailahun) chiefdoms and the new Jahn Chiefdom. Kpeje Bongre is now two chiefdoms (Kpeje and Bongre); their boundary is not yet known, so they are one here.
Includes some sections of Gbanti Kamaranka Chiefdom.
Lost the Barawa and Wollay sections of Nieni Chiefdom to Falaba District.
Name spelling corrected from "Fabala". Includes the Barawa and Wollay sections of Nieni Chiefdom.
Lost Wonde Chiefdom to Bandajuma District.
Lost the Sowa, Pejeh (Futa Peje), Barri, Makpele and Soro Gbema chiefdoms to Bandajuma District.
New district. Made from the Wonde (Bo), Sowa, Pejeh (Futa Peje), Barri, Makpele and Soro Gbema (Pujehun), and Langrama, Niawa and Tunkia (Kenema) chiefdoms.
Includes the sections of Gbanti Kamaranka Chiefdom that did not join Bombali.
